item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 12/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, it will be generally fine over southern China today. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cloudier and windier over the region. With the easterly airstream weakening, it will become humid over the coast of southern China over the weekend. It will be warm during the day.

Temp range: 15 - 22 C
R.H. range: 55 - 90 per Cent
